name: Low-Carb Ground Beef Stroganoff Skillet (Noodleless)

fit.evidence: 466 cal sits mid-band (400-650); 5.86g total carbs for the stroganoff alone, ~8g net even served over fried cabbage or cauliflower rice - deep under the 35g ceiling with headroom. Weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly to 14 servings; no seafood; budget meal-prep dinner. Clears every condition.

dupe_check.reason: Matches on three of four axes vs the catalog dish - protein (ground beef), sauce family (sour-cream/mushroom/Worcestershire stroganoff), and skillet method - differing only on starch: the catalog recipe is pasta-based, this is noodleless served over cabbage/cauliflower rice. Ruled KEEP because the noodleless low-carb reformulation is exactly what this run adds and the carb profile is a different plate (5.86g here vs a pasta dinner), analogous to 'beef chili' vs 'beef chili mac'. Flagged BORDERLINE because the protein+sauce core is genuinely identical to the existing pasta stroganoff and a reasonable reviewer could call it the same dinner minus the noodles - the decider should confirm the noodleless-vs-pasta distinction is enough to seat both.

cross_protein_twins: onepot-ground-turkey-stroganoff (turkey) is already in the catalog as the same-dish-different-protein twin; any low-carb/noodleless TURKEY stroganoff in another selector's pool would be structurally identical to this candidate - flag for the cross-protein merge pass.
pork-tenderloin-stroganoff-over-egg-noodles (pork) also exists but is a noodle-based tenderloin medallion dish, not a ground-meat structural twin of this skillet.
